SELECT article_id, group_cd, detail_cd, title, content, status_cd, view_cnt, upload_file_id, del_yn, reg_dt, reg_id, reg_ip, mod_dt, mod_id, mod_ip FROM post WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.sql:
WHERE del_yn = 'N'
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.title}, '%')
AND reg_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.regId}, '%')
AND reg_dt >= #{condition.startDate}
AND reg_dt < DATE_ADD(#{condition.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
